assertions.name: no_representative_of_4_1_can_meet_ito_thm2
assertions.source: floor 0 + Prop 2(2) => class max 1 < 3. A genuinely hyperbolic knot, excluded by proof rather than by sampling.

description: Applies Ito's Proposition 2 (attributed to Malyutin-Netsvetaev and Malyutin, quoted in the ingested library/arxiv-0805.1447v2) to upgrade the conjugacy-floor SEARCH to a structural exclusion. Prop 2(2) bounds the floor's variation over a conjugacy class by 1, so a floor-0 braid has no representative above 1 and can never meet Theorem 2's [beta]_D >= 3. Also checks the implementation against Prop 2(1), a theorem it was not built from, and confirms Prop 2(2) is tight on Ito's own pair.

attributed_by_ito_to: [MN] A. Malyutin, N. Netsvetaev, Dehornoy's ordering on the braid group and braid moves, St. Petersburg Math. J. 15, No.3 (2004), 437-448
[Ma] A. Malyutin, Twist number of (closed) braids, St. Petersburg Math. J. 16, No.5 (2005), 791-813
bound_source.convention_check: Ito's Remark 1 says his floor definition differs slightly from [Ma]'s and follows [MN]. Prop 2 is stated in ITO's convention, which is what _dehornoy.py implements and what was validated against Ito's three stated floors -- so it applies directly, with no reconciliation.
bound_source.neither_paper_is_ingested: arxiv.org is denied at CONNECT by this sandbox's proxy (403, policy), as are export.arxiv.org, link.springer.com and mathnet.ru. Not needed: the statement used is quoted in full in a document the corpus holds.

exclusion_by_prop2_2.geometry: HYPERBOLIC, Vol 7.3277 (proton carrier) -- a LINK, Thm 2 excludes it

corrects_my_own_scope_note.said: no Malyutin bound is invoked -- that paper is not in library/, so corpus-grep path 5 cannot support citing it
corrects_my_own_scope_note.actual: the bound is quoted in full in library/arxiv-0805.1447v2, in the SAME section whose conjugate pair that probe uses as its validation gate
corrects_my_own_scope_note.mechanical_cause: I grepped 'Malyutin' in library/INDEX.md and docs/ only. INDEX.md is ONE LINE PER DOCUMENT, so a result CITED INSIDE a held document is invisible to it by construction, and Malyutin has no document of his own here. AGENTS.md path 5 has three tiers; tier 1 answering 'no' is not tier 3 answering 'no'.
corrects_my_own_scope_note.what_changes: scope (a) search -> scope (b) structural exclusion with the invariant cited. The 118097-conjugate search becomes corroboration, and it corroborates twice: no counterexample, and its raising control saturates the bound.
corrects_my_own_scope_note.what_does_NOT_change: the numbers, and the reading. Ito's threshold still sits at 18 crossings and a genuinely hyperbolic knot still cannot reach it. The finding is now proved rather than sampled.
